issue.title: `UInput` applies `app.baseURL` twice to its leading avatar
issue.author: orbis
issue.body: ### Environment | | | | --- | --- | | **Nuxt version** | `4.6.2` | | **Modules** | `@acme/ui@4.12.0`, `@nuxt/image@2.2.0` | ### Version 4.6.2 ### Reproduction https://github.com/orbis/acme-input-baseurl ### Description With `app.baseURL: '/base/'`, the leading avatar of `UInput` renders ``, so the image 404s. A plain `NuxtImg` next to it renders `/base/_ipx/_/avatar.png`.
